build_hf_inference_task: build an HF Inference task client to call Hugging Face model inference endpoints with a specified task type
prepare_hf_inference_conversational: prepare a conversational chat completion request for an HF Inference model with messages and parameters
handle_hf_inference_binary_input: handle binary input for HF Inference tasks by encoding as base64 or sending raw content with parameters
check_supported_task: check whether a Hugging Face model supports a given inference task by inspecting its pipeline tag and tags
fetch_recommended_models: fetch recommended model IDs for each inference task from the Hugging Face API
